Nina (CSM): folks — need a short one-pager we can hand to a mid-market customer explaining practical runtime best-practices: prefill/prefetch, client batching, streaming fallback, TTLs, circuit breakers, and basic telemetry. Also want a checklist for onboarding steps and renewal-risk signals to capture.
Arjun (SE): ok! I'll draft a tight 1-page checklist. Will include both 'what we do' and 'what the customer should do'.
Arjun (SE): Draft bullets (keep these customer-facing):
• Prefill / warm: run a small set of synthetic requests 60–120 minutes before expected peaks to warm KV caches and tokenizers.
• Warm pools: enable a warm pool for the tenant or request Redwood to pre-allocate during critical windows.
• Client batching: suggest batch_size 4–8 for throughput; keep requests under ~256 tokens for latency-sensitive endpoints.
• Streaming + graceful fallback: enable streaming responses and set a 1.2s server-side timeout that falls back to a smaller model if the primary exceeds latency SLO.
• Cache TTLs: session-level prefixes = 1h, ephemeral user caches = 10–30m. Invalidate on model/rollout changes.
• Circuit breakers & retries: client should stop retrying after 3 quick retries; server circuit breaker trips at sustained 5xx >1% over 5 minutes.
• Telemetry to capture: median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_minute, prefill_success_rate, fallback_rate, 5xx_rate.
Arjun (SE): Example config snippet customers can paste into their client: 
```
// minimal client options
batch_size: 8
stream: true
prefill: { warm: true, window_minutes: 120 }
cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
retry_policy: { max_attempts: 3, backoff_ms: 200 }
```
Priya (CS Ops): Add onboarding checklist items for CS to run with the customer:
- Run preflight: call /health and run a 3-query sample generation.
- Schedule a 15m warmup 1–2 hours pre-launch.
- Confirm warm_pool setting or request dedicated pre-alloc from Redwood.
- Share a telemetry dashboard link and a simple query for median_response_ms and prefill_success_rate.
Priya (CS Ops): Renewal-risk signals to capture (auto-checks):
- usage_drop_pct > 30% week-over-week after day 14
- repeated failed generations in first 7 days
- decline in successful streaming sessions > 20%
Tom (SRE): Ops-side notes to include in the one-pager (customer-facing but short):
- We can enable a 1% canary traffic route and run a staged roll for model updates.
- If fallback_rate spikes, we timebox investigation and open an incident if 5xx_rate > 1% for 5m.
- Recommend enabling automatic fallback to the verified cost-optimized model for noncritical endpoints.
Arjun (SE): Quick prefill script customers can run (paste into terminal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","queries":["hello","summarize: short","extract entities: short"]}'
```

Nina (CSM): this is great — please turn the bullets into a clean 1-pager with two columns: 'What Redwood does' and 'What the customer should do', plus a 3-line summary at the top and the sample commands. I'll share with AE + customer and book a 15m warmup. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS Ops): will add the telemetry queries and the renewal flag rule (usage_drop_pct > 30% after week 2).
Arjun (SE): will drop the PDF here in the next hour.
Nina (CSM): thanks team — this will help reduce churn and make onboarding smoother.
